BEST (Board of European Students of Tech: BEST (Board of European Students of Technology) is a student organisation active in over 80 technical universities across Europe, with one main goal: developing students. LBG Chișinău has been part of BEST since 2007. Since then, our team has contributed to the academic, social and cultural development of countless European and Moldovan students.
Oameni, litere mari și multă energie — o: People, big letters and a lot of energy — a generation of BESTies Chișinău.
Totul a început în 1987, când studenți d: It all started in 1987, when students from 12 European universities met in Stockholm for the first International Week: the idea of a bridge between Europe's universities.
Un an mai târziu, la Grenoble, organizaț: A year later, in Grenoble, the organisation chose its name — BEST, Board of European Students of Technology — and in 1989, in Berlin, the first General Assembly laid its statutory foundations.
În 1991 au avut loc primele cursuri de v: The first summer courses took place in 1991, and since then the network has grown to dozens of local groups, gathered in regions and coordinated by an International Board and international departments.
Grupurile locale sunt inima organizației: Local groups are the heart of the organisation: they deliver the services, organise the events and sustain everything — people, resources, ideas.
Without LBGs, there is no BEST.
BEST este o asociație internațională vol: BEST is a voluntary, apolitical, non-profit, non-representative international association of European students of technology.
Tricouri roșii, prietenii vechi — spirit: Red hoodies, old friendships — the BEST spirit live.
În calitate de grup local BEST, misiunea: As a local BEST group, our mission is to help students passionate about the technical field reach their potential and live their best student years, giving them the chance to learn new things, develop new skills and discover the unique culture of our country.
La nivel internațional, BEST îi ajută pe: Internationally, BEST helps students achieve an international mind-set, reach a better understanding of cultures and societies and work in culturally diverse environments.
Dezvoltarea are loc atunci când suntem d: Development happens when we are open to people, ideas and different perspectives. Through diversity, we create a space where students can learn from one another, share their experiences and turn differences into new ideas.
Viziunea BEST este ca oamenii să înțelea: BEST's vision is that people understand and respect different cultures and societies — an environment of empowered diversity in which everyone applies their full potential and acts responsibly.
